mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a fair 70 degrees outside the Verona Public Library.

The City Clerk's Office has released candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election. All four Aldermanic seats are on the ballot, and candidates must file their paperwork by January 5, 2027, at 5:00 p.m. at City Hall.
Today features live music at Bailey's Run and a 50 year anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out live music at Paddy Mac's or visit the Crafty Fair at ART House 360.

Regarding recent activity, on November 6, officers responded to a business in the 500 block of West Verona Avenue where a woman was found passed out in her vehicle and was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Stop by for some delicious Snickers Swirl, which is today's flavor of the day. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:30 PM.
